name: Gamma Strategies Camelot Clearing single-sided deposit ratio-check bypass
summary: Gamma's Camelot/Algebra Clearing v1.2.3 gate contains an unsafe exception in getDepositAmount: whenever the vault totalSupply is zero or either getTotalAmounts component is zero, it returns amountStart = 0 and amountEnd = the opposite token's deposit maximum instead of enforcing the configured depositDelta/deltaScale ratio band. Concentrated-liquidity vaults become entirely single-sided when the pool price moves outside their ranges, so the attacker manipulated each pool into that state, made extremely imbalanced deposits that clearDeposit should have rejected, received shares priced at the manipulated spot price, restored the price and redeemed the disproportionate shares. Gamma's later security review identifies this single-sided ratio-check exception as the root cause and says the initially blamed threshold configuration was only a contributing condition.
notes: Clearing v1.2.3 is a plain non-upgradeable contract deployed directly by Gamma deployer 0x71e7d05be74ff748c45402c06a941c822d756dc5 in transaction 0x203d2c56abf456779509546101ee32d39efd95a32d000fd4b3091a2750ad0413 at Arbitrum block 103442465. The account is empty at block 103442464, and runtime hash 0xe0b3726ece505e92124109df6ea492e2b5dae631d406b51bab080dab825994e5 is identical at the deployment block, block 135157878 and block 166873291 immediately before the anchor. The EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero at block 166873291 and the verified runtime exposes no upgrade mechanism, so deployment is the only executable-code change. Mutable thresholds and per-vault settings are configuration context rather than the code-age basis.

Gamma's project post-mortem itemizes approximately $1.357M lost from the USDT-USDC.e Camelot vault 0x61a7b3dae70d943c6f2ea9ba4ffd2fecc6af15e4 and approximately $771K from the wstETH-WETH Camelot vault 0x3d53ac3abec01827caae5bc934d46b171cea2206. This record sums only those two non-overlapping figures ($2.128M), because both vaults route through Clearing 0x1f7792ed527a399159583730017cdb5003d57f4f and were attacked in one repeated same-chain campaign. It excludes the separately recorded gDAI-DAI leg through Clearing 0xb8fb4031dc09b6d999722d2c51def7c0cebf41e2 and the Ramses USDC-USDC.e leg through Clearing 0xcfb851b1b1345fe6c643e71f98b36ad887fa7db6. Gamma marks the per-vault amounts as approximate and does not publish an exact asset-level decomposition or valuation method, so the reported point estimate is medium confidence. The successful transactions in source-5 delimit the included campaign; no recovery is netted out.
USD loss is the sum of Gamma's approximate per-vault reported figures; no exact asset-level decomposition was published.

This record covers only the USDT-USDC.e and wstETH-WETH vaults gated by Clearing 0x1f7792ed527a399159583730017cdb5003d57f4f. The gDAI-DAI and Ramses legs have their own independently aged Clearing records and disjoint losses.
